governing_purpose: Construct a complete governed terrain of exact question implementations and continuity relations before typed collision generation or family authoring.

continuity_grains.within_wave: Exact source implementations, stems, modules, routing, response topology, and source-native groupings.
continuity_grains.within_source_all_waves: Longitudinal continuity, aliases, wording/scale changes, births, returns, splits, merges, narrowing, broadening, and explicit non-equivalence.
continuity_grains.cross_source_all_surveys: Portable equivalence, functional comparability, narrower/broader relations, analogies, false friends, and unresolved portability.

passes.name: 35-wave lightweight skeleton
passes.allowed: Catalog exact nodes and existing bindings; derive only shallow discovery tokens; expose gaps.
passes.forbidden: Deep continuity rulings, source-structure adjudication, family concepts, respondent joins.

passes.name: source-family deep pass
passes.allowed: Review all active waves of one survey together; source text, routing, universe, structures, exact aliases.
passes.forbidden: Cross-source authority before both sides are reviewed; family authoring.

passes.name: within-source continuity closure
passes.allowed: Issue positive and negative longitudinal edges and reconcile every likely lineage.

passes.name: global candidate refresh
passes.allowed: Generate provisional cross-source edges against reviewed sources and shallow unreviewed skeleton.

passes.name: all-survey reconciliation
passes.allowed: Resolve portability tiers after all nine sources are deeply reviewed.
passes.forbidden: Force every node into a universal concept.

passes.name: P2 closure
passes.allowed: Coverage, identity, determinism, provenance and unresolved-gap audit.
passes.forbidden: Begin candidate collision graph before closure.

identity_rules: Exact source variable case is identity-bearing.
Country enters implementation identity only for a material source/instrument difference.
Normalized text and lowercased keys are discovery aids only.
Question implementations and portable concepts are distinct objects.
cross_source_two_sided_rule: A cross-source continuity edge cannot become authoritative until both source families complete deep review.
completion_equation: expected governed implementations = cataloged implementations + explicit source gaps + explicit exclusions; no unexplained remainder.
